performance.verdict: Purchase drop is spend-driven, but ROAS held; 4 SOW milestones unresolved.

findings.text: OVERDUE: Aug 14 live-cooking event (Video/Content), Pre-launch gate, Platform ownership audit, and Funnel test+UTM (all Aug 31) — 4 milestones unresolved as of Sep 16.
3-day ROAS signal is positive: Sep 13–15 revenue totals $1,152.44 on $180.71 spend (~6.4x) vs Sep 10–12 revenue of $629.84 on $150.40 spend (~4.2x). Efficiency improving.
Purchases collapsed -56.25% week-over-week (16 prior 7d → 7 recent 7d), directly tracking the -17.46% spend cut; ROAS rose +14.45%, confirming fewer dollars bought fewer but efficient orders.
GBP actions dropped -48.78% week-over-week and show 3 consecutive zero-action days (Sep 13–15), while paid Meta spend held ~$60/day — organic visibility decoupled from paid activity.
Funnel test milestone (UTM + 100%-off code `ihbp8pmtn8`) still unresolved per SOW; Meta purchase pixel fires inconsistently via Shopify, meaning the Sep 15 $1,008.48 revenue day may be undercounted.

suggestions.text: Raise BWS - Sales - Muslims daily budget +20% (~+$11/day from ~$55) to recover purchase volume; ROAS floor holding at 5.4x.
suggestions.monday_update: The 3-day ROAS signal improved to ~6.4x (Sep 13–15, $1,152 revenue on $181 spend) while spend was pulled back -17.46%, directly causing the -56.25% purchase drop. Raise the BWS - Sales - Muslims daily budget by approximately 20% (~$11/day added) to recover order volume without risking the 5.4x ROAS floor. Success check: purchases return to 2+ per day and ROAS stays above 4.5x by Sep 22. Re-evaluate Sep 22.

suggestions.text: Close funnel test (code `ihbp8pmtn8`) and activate UTM parameters — blocking attribution truth and subscribe-page web work.
suggestions.monday_update: The Aug 31 SOW milestone for funnel test closure and UTM activation is 16 days overdue. Meta purchase pixel inconsistency (confirmed Shopify issue) means revenue like the Sep 15 $1,008.48 spike may be undercounted, and subscribe-page web work remains explicitly blocked on this result. Owner Khurram to close the test, document results, and confirm UTM firing via Windsor by Sep 19. Success check: Windsor shows UTM-tagged sessions matching Meta click volume within 20%.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 3 zero-action days (Sep 13–15) vs prior 28-day average of ~26 actions/day — re-check Sep 19.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped -48.78% week-over-week and hit zero for three consecutive days (Sep 13–15), while Meta spend continued at ~$60/day. This decoupling is probable rather than confirmed — it may reflect a GBP data reporting lag or a genuine local-visibility drop. No paid action is warranted yet. Re-check on Sep 19: if GBP actions remain below 15/day, escalate to Nacer for profile health check.
